items.headline: Board to consider Q2/H1 FY27 results and interim dividend on Nov 2, 2026; trading window shut Oct 1-Nov 4
MarketsMojo upgrades Amara Raja Energy & Mobility from Sell to Hold on valuation and technical shifts
Board approves additional Rs 550 cr investment in subsidiaries: Rs 500 cr in ARACT (gigafactory), Rs 50 cr in ARPSL
Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 4,215 cr (+23.9% YoY), PAT Rs 190.9 cr (+15.9%); Rs 150 cr infused into ARACT (total Rs 1,650 cr)
Andhra Pradesh PCB revokes Apr-2021 closure orders for Karakambadi and Nunegundlapalle plants; writ petitions withdrawn
ARACT commissions 60 MWh Customer Qualification Plant at Telangana Giga Corridor; Rs 500 cr invested
FY27 capex guided Rs 1,500-1,700 cr (Rs 400 cr lead-acid + Rs 1,100-1,200 cr new energy); Giga-1 2 GWh line targeted Jun-2027
